cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to acquaint students with the basics of production of gardening and ornamental horticulture. They will be introduced to the basics of growing technology, propagation, cultivation of realization cultivars, basic assortment. Basic topics production of vegetables, flowers and ornamental trees (incl. perennials).
